title: thymus serpyllum subsp. serpylloides
intro: Thymus serpyllum subsp. serpylloides, commonly known as creeping thyme, is a subspecies of the thyme plant, a low-growing, herbaceous perennial native to Europe and North Africa. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing stress, improving respiratory issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of creeping thyme include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies and essential oil blends. The bioactive constituents of Thymus serpyllum subsp. serpylloides include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
